# Rapier

> Fast Markdown editor for notes, diagrams, drawing and watercolor painting in one HTML file. Runs on Android, Web and Windows. Phone-first and offline. Work with a person through MCP and WebMCP, deliver an offline document, or embed the editor or lightweight reader in your app. Pictures, editable drawings and layout stay in one Markdown file. Optional encrypted sync uses your own Cloudflare account.

For a live document, connect an MCP client to `https://mcp.rapier.website/mcp`, then call `rapier.open`. It returns `document` and `editor_url`; pass `document` on later calls and keep it private. Read `document.observe` before editing. If no editor is open, export the offline editor with `document.export` and `format: "html"`, then deliver its returned file. A new browser pairs with the workspace before it can edit.

The agent edits live, beside the person or while they are away. Rapier shows the agent's presence and its changes. The person taps a change to see what was there before and undoes anything, preserving later edits. `comparison.present` lets the agent deliberately show a diff.

## Start here

- [1. Work with a person in one live document](https://rapier.website/agents): connect to `https://mcp.rapier.website/mcp`, then `rapier.open`. Read, write, draw, paint, review and undo together. The person's typing wins overlapping changes.
- [2. Hand someone one offline HTML file](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/tree/main/npm/rapier-html): run `npx rapier-html notes.md`. It writes `notes.rapier.html`, with the editor and document inside. `npx rapier-html revised.md --compare original.md` opens the edited document with its before for comparison.
- [3. Put the editor or reader in your app](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/tree/main/npm/rapier-embed): install `rapier-embed` and call `Rapier.mount`. Your app owns storage and revisions. Enable the editor's `agent: true` for your own agent over WebMCP; the reader has no agent tools.
- [4. Keep pictures, editable drawings and layout in one Markdown file](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/tree/main/npm/rapier-markdown-kit): use `rapier-markdown-kit` to read, write and render Self-contained Markdown. Respect [Will/1](https://github.com/jackskip22/will) regions: `keep` preserves the region, `append` permits additions at its end, and `edit` permits changes.
- [5. Encode JPEG XL anywhere JavaScript runs](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-jxl): use `rapier-jxl` for lossless pixels, photographs and JPEG transcoding, offline. Choose the core, optional modules or complete worker.
- [6. Run the door on your own storage](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier/tree/main/server): run `rapier-server` over your own folder or S3-compatible bucket, with the same document tools.

## Work in the document

- [Agent guide](https://rapier.website/agents): `document.observe` reads the document state and the person's current focus. `document.outline` and `document.find` locate passages; `document.read` discloses exact source with handles. `document.edit` changes inspected text in one transaction. Read again after a stale handle; preserve Will regions and the person's current work.
- [Draw and paint](https://rapier.website/agents#draw-and-paint): `document.draw` creates native editable SVG diagrams from a `figures` list, adds brush or watercolor strokes, and updates inspected drawings. The person can move the shapes. Mermaid remains Markdown source.
- [Changes and delivery](https://rapier.website/agents): `comparison.present` deliberately shows a diff. Each source change returns its act; `document.undo` reverses an identified act or turn while preserving later edits. `document.export` supports Markdown, the offline HTML editor, text, a web page, Word and PDF. `document.create_return` adds an optional one-use Send back path to an offline editor.
- [Live tool schemas](https://rapier.website/AGENT-TOOLS.json): tool inputs and effects. Use the connected server's `tools/list` for the tools available in that connection. `rapier.guide` returns the usage guide.

## Choose a build

- [rapier.html](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier/raw/main/rapier.html): the complete app, with editing, Notes, Draw, Paint, Water and the JPEG XL encoder. One offline HTML file.
- [rapier-document.html](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier/raw/main/rapier-document.html): the editor without Notes, Draw, Paint or the encoder. Agent-created SVG diagrams still work. Use it when people edit inside your app.
- [rapier-reader.html](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier/raw/main/rapier-reader.html): the read-only reader, about 190 kB gzipped. Search, text in pictures, headings, reading settings, read aloud, copy, share and print. No editing or agent tools. Add fonts and styles with `rapier-embed`.
- [Local builds and plug-ins](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins/tree/main/npm/rapier-embed): keep the HTML and its optional plug-ins in your codebase. `npx rapier-embed plugins ./public/rapier` downloads and verifies the manifest's files. Mount with `build: 'reader'`, your local `src`, and `plugins: '/rapier/'`.

## Reference

- [Self-contained Markdown](https://rapier.website/markdown-standard): CommonMark and GFM with pictures, editable drawings and layout in ordinary reference definitions and HTML comments. Other Markdown apps can read the file.
- [Will/1](https://rapier.website/will): document regions and the agent's editing obligations.
- [Embed contract](https://rapier.website/docs/embed-contract.md): document loading, confirmed saves, revisions, styling, plug-ins and WebMCP.
- [Plugins and skills](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier-plugins): host installation, four document skills and npm packages. For Claude Code, run `claude plugin marketplace add jackskip22/rapier-plugins`, then `claude plugin install rapier@rapier`.
- [MCP connection metadata](https://rapier.website/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): the public server identity and streamable HTTP endpoint. The registry name is `io.github.jackskip22/rapier`.
- [Complete public reference](https://rapier.website/llms-full.txt): the public guides and skills together.
- [Source and downloads](https://github.com/jackskip22/rapier): the app and source under AGPL-3.0-only; the Markdown kit, embed helper, Will and JPEG XL encoder use MIT.

## Optional

- [Notes](https://rapier.website/notes): Markdown notes and optional encrypted sync. Agents use `notes.find`, `notes.read`, `notes.open`, `notes.write`, `notes.history`, `notes.set` and `notes.sync` on the store configured by their host, naming each note by the opaque NoteRef `notes.find` returns. Writes join the note's history; opening the note keeps that same history for before previews and Undo.
- [Connection details](https://rapier.website/agents#connect): `/mcp` accepts MCP clients with or without OAuth. `/muse` accepts OAuth-connected hosts and has no embedded editor. An editor page offers WebMCP through `document.modelContext` when the browser provides it, and the in-page API `window.RapierAgentBrowser.invoke(name, input)`.
- [Privacy and data](https://rapier.website/privacy): hosted workspaces expire after 30 idle days; export links last 24 hours. Downloaded files remain independent.
